# maintenance-window-subtraction

Behavior contract:
freeSlots(window, blocked) uses integer half-open intervals [start,end). window has start <= end. Each blocked interval also has start <= end, may overlap another and may lie outside the window. Return maximal nonempty free intervals sorted ascending after subtracting the union of blocked intervals, clipping to window. Zero-length intervals block nothing. Do not mutate window or blocked.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
